_sources.listing: Google Business Profile, read in the user's own Chrome via Claude in Chrome (2026-11-28): 'Caudillo General Carpentry', 5.0 stars, 2 reviews (both 5 stars, rating only, no text), category 'General contractor', Amarillo, TX 79106, phone +1 806-444-7632 (matches the sheet), unclaimed ('Claim this business'), no hours, no website, no photos.
_sources.services: Google search results (2026-11-28): their Facebook page is titled 'Caudillo General Carpentry - roofing,siding,windows,doors' with the snippet 'We do free estimates..quality work...we also compare prices'; MapQuest: 'specializing in a wide range of general carpentry services'. Phone (806) 444-7632 also on BBB (Woodworking, not accredited) and ChamberofCommerce.com. Yelp/Yahoo list an older number (806) 881-3755; the page uses the Google/BBB number.
_sources.brand: No brand online and no listing photo to sample, so brand is omitted and the default palette applies. Concept mark (open door) is original, in the default colours.

gap: Unclaimed and invisible: the Google listing is unclaimed with no website, photos or hours, so even with a 5.0 rating there's nothing for an Amarillo homeowner to look at and no way to ask for a free estimate except calling.
